name: FAKE5
author: swtdr34mz
summary: A polysynth in the manner of the Sequential Take 5: two oscillators per voice with continuous shape (sine, saw, square, narrowing pulse), sub and noise, sync and analog-style linear FM 2>1, a Prophet-5-style 4-pole low-pass with drive, two DADSR envelopes with env routing, a global and a per-voice LFO, sixteen mod slots, vintage, overdrive, twelve effects and a lush plate reverb, arp and 64-step sequencer, unison with chord memory, 5 or 10 voices. ECO and HIGH quality. Panel-style touch pages.
